_note: Project decisions seeded before the coding job runs. They are deliberately NOT restated in the brief: whether the app follows them is a question for the human reviewer, not an instruction the brief hands over. `verify:review-app` seeds these through POST /api/memories and records their ids and revisions in the packet, so the review cites the exact text that was in force.

decisions.content: Never use modal dialogs — alert(), confirm(), prompt() or overlay modals — for feedback; report results in inline status text.
Body text keeps a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its own background.
At most one accent colour is used per screen; everything else is neutral.
Every destructive action can be undone from the same screen.
